text.p: Close of play on the opening day of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Wednesday:
At Chelmsford: Essex 237 (A.Grayson 76, S.Law 63; N Killeen 4-50, S.Brown 4-54); Durham 122-3 (P.Collingwood 62).
At Southampton: Hampshire 285 (K.James 56 not out; A.Mullally 4-69); Leicestershire 2-0.
At Old Trafford: Lancashire 125 (J.Crawley 51 not out;K.Evans 6-40); Nottinghamshire 128-4 (P Johnson 52 not out).
At Edgbaston: Yorkshire 233 (D.Lehmann 62, M.Vaughan 56; A.Giles 4-54, A.Donald 4-55). Warwickshire 64-4.
At Fenner's: Cambridge University 280-9 declared (W.House 68, R.Jones 60, E.Smith 59; J.Brown 4-50); Northamptonshire 10-0.
At The Parks: Worcestershire 359-2 declared (G.Hick 164 not out, W.Weston 119); Oxford University 36-0.
